headline_marked: Shai Hope century leads [[West Indies beat India by 6 wickets]] in record chase
headline: Shai Hope century leads West Indies beat India by 6 wickets in record chase
summary: The visitors overhauling a target of 250 is the second-highest successful run chase in men's T20 international history.
details: West Indies completed their highest successful chase in T20 internationals, chasing down 250 to beat India by six wickets on Friday in Ranchi.
Shai Hope anchored the victory with an unbeaten 102 from 45 deliveries, guiding the visitors home with nine balls to spare.
Despite an early collapse where Mayank Yadav removed Pooran and Hetmyer with successive deliveries, Hope and Sherfane Rutherford turned the match around.
The pair shared a blistering 120-run partnership for the fourth wicket, with Rutherford hammering 84 off 37 balls before falling to Kuldeep Yadav.
Earlier, India posted a massive total of 249-5, underpinned by Sanju Samson's 82 off 41 balls and a late surge by Iyer and Tilak Varma.
The win levels the five-match series at 1-1 after a high-scoring encounter that saw a total of 501 runs scored in the match.
This chase is the second-highest successful run chase in men's T20 international history, surpassed only by South Africa's 259 against West Indies in 2023.
caption:
A record-breaking chase! West Indies hunt down 250 to stun India.

Despite an early collapse where Mayank Yadav removed Pooran and Hetmyer with successive deliveries, Hope and Sherfane Rutherford turned the match around.

The pair shared a blistering 120-run partnership for the fourth wicket, with Rutherford hammering 84 off 37 balls before falling to Kuldeep Yadav.

Earlier, India posted a massive total of 249-5, underpinned by Sanju Samson's 82 off 41 balls and a late surge by Iyer and Tilak Varma.

The win levels the five-match series at 1-1 after a high-scoring encounter that saw a total of 501 runs scored in the match.

This chase is the second-highest successful run chase in men's T20 international history, surpassed only by South Africa's 259 against West Indies in 2023.

headline_marked: Tk3 crore looted in Sreepur: [[bKash agent's car shot at]] by gang
headline: Tk3 crore looted in Sreepur: bKash agent's car shot at by gang
summary: Gunmen on 10 motorcycles intercepted a private car carrying cash for a bKash agent, shooting and hacking the staff before fleeing with the money.
details: A gang of robbers intercepted a private car carrying cash for a bKash agent in the Karnpur area of the Sreepur-Goshinga road in Gazipur on Friday evening.
The attackers, arriving on approximately 10 motorcycles, blocked the vehicle's path and smashed the car windows with cleavers.
During the attack, the agency's account manager, 29-year-old Md. Himel, was shot in the stomach, while another official, Md. Fahad, was hacked with a cleaver.
The driver was also beaten, and the robbers looted two out of three bags of cash, totaling over Tk3 crore, before fleeing the scene within two minutes.
The victims were employees of 'Bhaluka Channel Enterprise Sreepur Limited', a bKash agent office located at Maona crossing.
The cash had been collected from a distribution office in Narsingdi and was being transported back to Maona crossing.
The injured account manager was initially treated at the Sreepur Upazila Health Complex and later shifted to Shaheed Tajuddin Ahmed Medical College Hospital for advanced care.
Sreepur Police Station OC Mohammad Shahinur Alam confirmed that police have reached the spot and are taking necessary legal action to investigate the crime.
